title: Bedenkliche, kontraproduktive Inhaltsstoffe!
review: Ich habe mir dieses Duschöl gekauft in der Hoffnung, nach dem Duschen meine Hautreizungen zu lindern und dem Juckreiz entgegenzuwirken. Leider hat sich der erwünschte Erfolg nicht eingestellt, woraufhin ich mal auf Codecheck nachsehen wollte, was denn da alles an Inhaltsstoffen drinnen ist. Ich war schockiert zu sehen, dass da mehrere bedenkliche Inhaltsstoffe drinnen sind, welche absolut nicht geeignet für die (empfindliche) Haut sind:- PPG-5-Ceteth-20 (Schwächt die Barrierefunktion der Haut.)- Polysorbate 20 (= schwer abbaubares Polymer = Mikroplastik)- Sodium Laureth Sulfate (Schwächt die Barrierefunktion der Haut. Kann irritierend im Kontakt mit Augen und Haut wirken. Effekte verstärken sich mit langer Wirkdauer und bei häufigem Gebrauch.)Für das Geld kann man sich in der Drogerie mehrere Flaschen billiges Duschgel kaufen. Da hat man wenigstens mehr davon und die Qualität ist dieselbe.

title: Absolutely NOT!
review: Firstly, this isn't an oil, it's a foaming cleanser.I've used multiple different cleansing oils from varied brands and I'm shocked by the claims for this one. The description literally says "...formulated for dry to very dry sensitive skin." and goes on to say "...protects the skin against the drying effects of hard water." Whilst I was very surprised to find that it was a foaming cleanser, I gave it a shot, only to find that upon removing the product from my face, my skin was tight and felt very dry.The description goes on to say "...daily gentle cleanser" however there is nothing gentle about the way this feels if you are unfortunate enough to get just the tiniest bit near or in your eyes. Again, I've used multiple cleansers (oil and others) and have had the occasion where it goes in your eyes. This was definitely one of the worst experiences from that kind of situation.Given the standing of this brand, I am really surprised and very unimpressed by this product. I will not be buying it again and will question whether or not to buy anything else from this brand either

Non lascia la pelle unta, ma la rende morbida, idratata e lenita subito dopo la doccia.Ho notato che riduce molto la sensazione di prurito e secchezza, soprattutto nei periodi in cui la pelle tende a tirare di più. La profumazione è molto leggera e piacevole, non invadente.Il formato grande con dispenser è super pratico e dura tantissimo. Rapporto qualità-prezzo ottimo considerando che basta poco prodotto per ogni utilizzo.Lo consiglio a chiunque abbia pelle secca, sensibile o soggetta ad irritazioni: fa davvero la differenza anche nella skincare quotidiana.La confezione da 1 l super conveniente

title: La Roche-Posay Lipikar Huile Lavante AP+ Review – A Gentle, Nourishing Body Wash
review: **La Roche-Posay Lipikar Huile Lavante AP+ Review – A Gentle, Nourishing Body Wash for Dry, Sensitive Skin**I’ve been using this body wash for a few months now, and it’s become a staple in my shower routine—especially during the colder months when my skin gets dry and irritable. Unlike most shower gels that leave my skin tight or stripped, this one feels more like a moisturizing treatment than a cleanser.The texture is unique—it’s an oil-based formula that turns into a light, creamy lather when mixed with water. It doesn’t foam up as much as regular shower gels, but that’s part of what makes it so gentle. It rinses off cleanly without any weird residue, and my skin immediately feels softer, almost as if I’ve already applied lotion.What stands out most is how well it works for sensitive or eczema-prone skin. I occasionally get patches of dryness on my arms, and this doesn’t aggravate them at all. The formula is fragrance-free (just a mild, neutral scent from the ingredients) and packed with nourishing elements like niacinamide and shea butter. It’s also approved by dermatologists, which gives me extra confidence in using it daily.The bottle is practical with a pump dispenser, though I wish it were a bit bigger for the price. A little goes a long way, so it still lasts a while, but if you’re using it for the whole family, you might run through it faster.The only downside? If you love heavily scented, foamy washes, this might feel too “clinical” at first. But for anyone dealing with dryness, sensitivity, or just wanting a hydrating cleanse, it’s worth every penny.**Final Verdict (4.5/5)** – One of the best body washes for dry, sensitive skin. Not the cheapest, but the results speak for themselves. I’ll keep repurchasing.

title: Muito bom!
review: Apesar de ser mais direcionado a pessoas com pele seca, pelo menos é o que diz a embalagem, eu que tenho a pele normal para oleosa, tenho utilizado para poder regular minha oleosidade do rosto e consequentemente diminuir meus poros. Junto ao cleasing oil, também utilizo a niacinamida da La Roche, e pois bem, tem dado muito certo, sinto a oleosidade menor, e também meus poros diminuídos. Não utilizo todos os dias, normalmente um dia sim e um dia não, já que o grande propósito pra o meu uso é o de retirar a sujidades provenientes do dia a dia e dos produtos diários que uso, como o protetor solar. Eu vinha tendo cravos de sujeira, que pareciam ser resquícios desses produtos, e mesmo que eu diariamente utilizasse gel de limpeza, estava sendo insuficiente. Além disso, consegui adquirir o produto em uma promoção que tornou o custo benefício muito maior, era de longe o mais barato dos cleasing oils. Ah, o produto pode ser utilizado em todo o corpo e também nos cabelos, e é ideal para pessoas mais sensíveis, que não é o meu caso.
